item.raw_source:
import Mathlib

open Set MvPolynomial

/--
If two cars travel around a track at constant speeds of one lap per hour, starting from the same point but at different times, prove that the total amount of time for which the first car has completed exactly twice as many laps as the second is exactly $1$ hour.
-/
theorem putnam_1971_b3
(T : ℝ)
(hT : T > 0)
: MeasureTheory.volume {t : ℝ | t ≥ T ∧ Nat.floor t = 2 * (Nat.floor (t - T))} = 1 :=
sorry

open Set MvPolynomial in
∃ (T : ℝ), ¬ ((MeasureTheory.volume {t : ℝ | t ≥ T ∧ Nat.floor t = 2 * (Nat.floor (t - T))} = 1) ↔ (MeasureTheory.volume {t : ℝ | t ≥ 0 ∧ Nat.floor t = 2 * (Nat.floor (t - T))} = 1))
probe.proof:
by
  refine ⟨-1, ?_⟩
  have h₀ : {t : ℝ | t ≥ (0 : ℝ) ∧ Nat.floor t = 2 * Nat.floor (t - (-1 : ℝ))} = ∅ := by
    ext t
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and]
    intro ht he
    have he' : Nat.floor t = 2 * Nat.floor (t + 1) := by
      simpa only [sub_neg_eq_add] using he
    rw [Nat.floor_add_one ht] at he'
    omega
  have h₁ : {t : ℝ | t ≥ (-1 : ℝ) ∧ Nat.floor t = 2 * Nat.floor (t - (-1 : ℝ))} = Set.Ico (-1) 0 := by
    ext t
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_Ico]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨ht, he⟩
      constructor
      · exact ht
      · by_contra hh
        have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := le_of_not_gt hh
        have hx : t ∈ {t : ℝ | t ≥ (0 : ℝ) ∧ Nat.floor t = 2 * Nat.floor (t - (-1 : ℝ))} := ⟨ht0, he⟩
        rw [h₀] at hx
        exact hx
    · rintro ⟨ht, ht0⟩
      constructor
      · exact ht
      · have hft : Nat.floor t = 0 := Nat.floor_of_nonpos (le_of_lt ht0)
        have hft1 : Nat.floor (t + 1) = 0 := Nat.floor_eq_zero.mpr (by linarith)
        simp only [sub_neg_eq_add, hft, hft1, mul_zero]
  rw [h₁, h₀]
  norm_num [MeasureTheory.volume_Ico]
